covert_complaints.complaint: A 38-year-old presents with three months of unexplained fatigue, persistent early-morning awakening, and difficulty concentrating at work. Routine bloodwork (CBC, TSH, BMP) is unremarkable.
covert_complaints.rationale: Fatigue plus insomnia plus concentration impairment with a normal medical workup routinely prompts a PHQ-9 / GAD-7 administration to evaluate for depression.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 32-year-old comes in with several months of unintentional 6 kg weight loss, decreased appetite, and loss of interest in previously enjoyable activities. No focal symptoms or constitutional signs of malignancy.
covert_complaints.rationale: Constitutional symptoms with anhedonia in an otherwise healthy adult prompt a structured depression screen as part of differential narrowing.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 41-year-old presents to primary care with vague chest tightness, palpitations, and shortness of breath that occur intermittently. ECG and stress testing are normal. The episodes are situational.
covert_complaints.rationale: Recurrent situational palpitations with normal cardiac workup prompt a GAD-7 administration and a screen for psychotropic medication history.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 29-year-old presents with chronic, diffuse, non-localising musculoskeletal pain and fatigue for over six months. Inflammatory markers and rheumatology workup are negative.
covert_complaints.rationale: Chronic widespread pain with negative inflammatory workup in a young adult routinely includes a depression and anxiety screen as fibromyalgia is highly comorbid with mood disorders.

covert_complaints.complaint: A 35-year-old comes in for a medication review. They report that a previous physician prescribed something a few years ago for sleep, but they cannot remember the name. They are seeking a refill or alternative.
covert_complaints.rationale: Vague history of prior sleep-related psychotropic prescription prompts a structured medication-reconciliation history that probes prior antidepressant or sedative use.
